title: Auth Tokens v2 — API Payload Design

raw.file_name: Auth Tokens v2 — API Payload Design

comments.author: priya-nair
comments.text: Proposed v2 token payload posted. Changes from v1: adds `tenantId` (string) and `scopes` (string array). The scopes list is what Atlas needs for premium tier gating. Waiting on PM sign-off for field names before implementing. Comments welcome.

comments.author: kai-zhang
comments.text: Scope naming convention: should these be `billing:read` style (resource:action) or flat strings like `premium_access`? Resource:action is more flexible and OAuth-aligned.

comments.author: priya-nair
comments.text: Agreed on resource:action — including that recommendation in the PM doc. `billing:read`, `billing:write`, `analytics:read`, `premium:access` as the initial scope set.

title: Lumen Component Library — Design Token Spec

raw.file_name: Lumen Component Library — Design Token Spec

comments.author: alice-design
comments.text: Token spec published for the component library migration. All colors, typography, spacing, and shadow values are now in the Figma token plugin. Kai — these are the values to pull into the codebase for LMNE-21.

comments.author: kai-zhang
comments.text: Perfect timing. Starting the migration PR this sprint. Will use Style Dictionary to export from Figma tokens to CSS custom properties and TypeScript constants.

comments.author: alice-design
comments.text: One thing to note: the dark mode token overrides are in a separate 'Dark' collection in the token plugin. Make sure the export handles both light and dark sets.
